name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: Start on all fours. Inhale as you arch your back and look up (cow). Exhale as you round your back and tuck your chin (cat). Flow between the two positions.
coaching_cue: Move slowly and breathe with each transition. Let the movement flow through your entire spine.
common_mistakes: Moving too fast, holding breath, only moving the head and not the whole spine.
modification: Perform seated in a chair if getting on the floor is uncomfortable.
advanced_progression: Add a reach-through (thread the needle) at each cat position.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Step into a deep lunge. Place the hand on the same side as the front foot on the floor inside the front foot. Rotate your torso and reach the other arm toward the ceiling. Hold, then switch sides.
coaching_cue: Drive your front knee out over your pinky toe and rotate through your mid-back, not your lower back.
common_mistakes: Not stepping far enough, rounding the upper back, rushing the rotation.
modification: Keep the back knee on the floor and skip the rotation.
advanced_progression: Add a hamstring stretch by straightening the front leg between reps.

name: Standing Hip Circles
instructions: Stand on one leg (use a wall for balance if needed). Lift the other knee up and circle it outward, then reverse. Keep your torso still.
coaching_cue: Make the circles as large as your range of motion allows while keeping your standing leg stable.
common_mistakes: Moving the torso instead of the hip, making circles too small, rushing.
modification: Hold a wall or chair for balance.
low_impact_alternative: Seated hip circles in a chair.
advanced_progression: Perform without holding anything for balance.

name: Seated Thoracic Rotation
instructions: Sit on the floor or a chair with hands crossed over your chest. Rotate your upper body to one side as far as comfortable, hold briefly, then rotate to the other side.
coaching_cue: Keep your hips facing forward — all the movement should come from your mid-back.
common_mistakes: Rotating from the lower back, moving the hips, not going far enough.
modification: Perform lying on your side with knees bent (open book stretch).
advanced_progression: Add a resistance band for overpressure at end range.

name: Ankle Circles
instructions: Sit or stand (hold something for balance). Lift one foot and draw circles with your toes, rotating the ankle. Complete circles in both directions, then switch feet.
coaching_cue: Make the circles as large as possible to work through the full range of motion.
common_mistakes: Moving the whole leg instead of just the ankle, making circles too small.
modification: Sit in a chair for stability.
advanced_progression: Perform standing on one leg without holding anything.

name: Shoulder Pass-Through
instructions: Hold a resistance band (or towel) with a wide grip in front of your body. Keeping arms straight, bring the band overhead and behind your body in an arc, then return.
coaching_cue: Use a wide enough grip that you can complete the full arc without bending your elbows.
common_mistakes: Grip too narrow (straining shoulders), bending elbows, arching the lower back.
modification: Use a wider grip or a longer band/towel.
advanced_progression: Gradually narrow the grip over time as mobility improves.
